### ClanChat

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.chat`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.chat.ClanChat → org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.chat.ClanChat  

**Methods:**
```java
static List<ClanChatMember> getMembers();
static String getName();
static String getOwner();
static ClanChatTab getSelected();
static int getSize();
static boolean inChat();
static boolean inChat(String name);
static boolean isOpen(ClanChatTab tab);
static boolean join(String clanChat);
static boolean leave();
static boolean openChatTab(ClanChatTab tab);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getMembers()` | Gets a list of the clan members in your chat |
| `getName()` | Gets clan chat name |
| `getOwner()` | Gets clan chat owner's name |
| `getSelected()` | Gets the currently selected ClanChatTab, Clan Tab open/closed is irrelevant |
| `getSize()` | Gets the current size of the clan chat |
| `inChat()` | Checks whether you're in any clan chat |
| `inChat(String name)` | Checks whether you're in a given clan chat Names are formatted to replace all non-alphabetical/numerical characters with spaces |
| `isOpen(ClanChatTab tab)` | Checks to see if a given clan chat tab is currently open, including checking the clan tab itself |
| `join(String clanChat)` | Joins a clan chat specified by the name If you're already in a chat but not the specified chat, it will leave your current chat |
| `leave()` | Leaves the current clan chat you're in |
| `openChatTab(ClanChatTab tab)` | Opens a given clan chat tab |

### ClanMember

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.guild`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.guild.ClanMember → org.dreambot.api.methods.clan.guild.ClanMember  

**Methods:**
```java
String getName();
byte getRankValue();
int getWorld();
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getName()` | Returns a formatted version of the clan member's name Formatted means replacing all non-alphabetical/numeric characters with spaces ex: "jack_sparrow" would return "jack sparrow" |
| `getRankValue()` | Gets a byte value for the clan member's rank Currently we do not have what these values map to as actual ranks. |
